setup.intro.welcome: Welcome! HA NOVA lets your AI assistant run your Home Assistant.
setup.intro.steps: Steps: pick your AI client, find Home Assistant, add the NOVA App, connect this computer, install the skills.
setup.intro.browser: When a browser page opens, finish there and come back here.
setup.intro.owner: You need the Home Assistant owner's account.
setup.intro.link_only: Home Assistant Link only: the NOVA App must already be installed.
setup.menu.hint: Use ↑/↓ or j/k, Enter to select, Ctrl+C to exit
setup.menu.hint_back: Use ↑/↓ or j/k, Enter to select, Esc to go back, Ctrl+C to exit
setup.menu.invalid_choice: Invalid choice. Please enter one of the listed options.
setup.clients.question: Which AI client do you use?
setup.clients.all_unavailable: install a supported AI client first
setup.clients.none_ready: No supported AI client is ready on this machine yet.
setup.clients.install_first: Install one supported client first, then rerun: ha-nova setup
setup.token.question: Choose how to set up the Relay Auth Token:
setup.token.paste: Paste existing token from another device / Home Assistant
setup.discovery.local_name_fragile: .local names can stop working (especially on Windows); its IP address is safer: type it below.
setup.discovery.find_ip: Find it in Home Assistant: Settings > System > Network.
setup.discovery.none_saved: No Home Assistant found automatically; starting from your saved address {host}
setup.discovery.none: No Home Assistant found automatically; enter its address.
setup.done.example_light: Turn off the living room light
setup.done.legacy_token: This device still connects with the shared legacy token.
setup.done.legacy_switch:
Switch to its own revocable credential: run 'ha-nova pair' and
enter a fresh code from the NOVA page ("Connect a device").
setup.done.connection_away: Away from home: Ready — Home Assistant Link
setup.done.connection_routing: Routing:        Automatic — Home Assistant Link is used only when local access is unavailable
setup.incomplete.title: Setup incomplete
setup.incomplete.ws_degraded: The NOVA App is reachable, but its Home Assistant connection is not up yet.
setup.incomplete.ws_degraded_fix: Open Home Assistant > Settings > Apps > NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons), verify the app settings, and restart the App.
setup.incomplete.relay_unreachable: HA NOVA saved your local setup, but the relay could not be verified yet.
setup.incomplete.relay_unreachable_fix: Open Home Assistant > Settings > Apps > NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons) and start the app.
setup.incomplete.skills: The Home Assistant connection is configured, but local skill installation still needs another run.
setup.incomplete.skills_fix: Re-run setup or install the HA NOVA skills again for your client.
setup.incomplete.link: Local access and skills are ready, but the selected Home Assistant Link connection is not.
setup.incomplete.link_fix: Re-run setup to resume Home Assistant Link authorization; local access remains available.
setup.incomplete.generic: HA NOVA saved your local setup, but the system is not fully ready yet.
setup.incomplete.rerun: Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.
setup.resumed_pairing: Resumed the interrupted pairing — this device is connected.
setup.prompt.open_browser: Press Enter to open your browser
setup.link.unavailable_build: Home Assistant Link access is unavailable because this build or platform has Cloud setup disabled.
setup.service.credential_moved: Moved this install's device credential into protected service file storage.
setup.storage.file_backed: No OS keyring is reachable here — this device will pair with secure file-backed storage instead of a shared token.
setup.storage.warn_session_unavailable: secure storage unavailable in this Linux session; run HA NOVA from a terminal inside the Linux desktop session on this machine so local secure storage is available
setup.storage.warn_unavailable: secure storage unavailable on this Linux machine; start a Secret Service provider (for example GNOME Keyring or KWallet Secrets) before finishing setup
setup.storage.warn_not_initialized: secure storage is present but not initialized on this Linux machine; finish local secure storage setup before finishing setup
setup.storage.warn_locked: secure storage is present but locked on this Linux machine; unlock the default keyring before finishing setup
setup.storage.warn_not_ready: secure storage is present but not ready on this Linux machine; finish local secure storage setup before finishing setup
setup.host.saved_unusable: The saved address {url} could not be used. Enter a new one.
setup.token.separate_access: NOVA keeps client and Home Assistant access separate:
setup.token.separate_relay: a) This Relay token protects the connection from this computer
setup.token.separate_app: b) The Home Assistant App receives its upstream access automatically
setup.token.standalone: Standalone Container/Core relays keep HA_LLAT in the server environment; the CLI never asks for it.
setup.token.using_flag: Using the Relay Auth Token you already provided.
setup.token.generated: Here is your relay token (generated automatically):
setup.token.next_on_app_page: Next, on the NOVA App page:
setup.token.app_step_paste: 2. Paste the token into the "Relay Auth Token" field ("relay_auth_token")
setup.token.app_step_restart: 4. Restart the App so it picks up the new token
setup.token.wait_saved: Press Enter after you saved the Relay Auth Token and restarted the NOVA App
setup.token.reuse_note: If this token already works on another device, the next verification step should succeed without any new Home Assistant changes.
setup.verify.device_not_answering: Paired, but the secure device endpoint did not answer yet. The App may still be starting.
setup.verify.adding_link: Local access is ready. Now connecting Home Assistant Link for away-from-home access.
setup.error.inspect_retirement: cannot inspect interrupted device credential retirement: {error}
setup.error.finish_retirement: cannot finish the interrupted device credential retirement: {error}
setup.error.service_needs_client: service credentials require a specific client; use: ha-nova setup --service <client>
setup.error.service_move_credential: cannot move the device credential into service file storage: {error}
setup.error.profile_identity: cannot prepare the server profile identity: {error}
